text: Rejected a hard zero-tolerance gate on unevidenced criteria. 165 criteria fail today (146 unredeemed '(once built)' promises on shipped specs, 19 asserting yes while naming nothing), so a zero gate would have broken make check on the first run and been disabled within a day. Chose a ratchet against _spec/.criteria-debt instead: BROKEN pointers fail at zero tolerance immediately, the rest can only go down.
